error[ZBX-E0103]: cgroup v2 is not set up for this user
  cause  the cgroup v2 at /sys/fs/cgroup lacks the controllers: cpu memory pids,
         so zbx has no cgroup to limit a container with
  fix    have the host enable them in the parent's cgroup.subtree_control
  more   zbx explain E0103 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0103.html

error[ZBX-E0105]: uid and gid mapping is not set up
  cause  root (uid 0); no subuid range of 65536 ids (largest: 0); no subgid
         range of 65536 ids (largest: 0)
  fix    give this user id ranges:   sudo usermod --add-subuids 100000-165535 --add-subgids 100000-165535 $(id -un)
  more   zbx explain E0105 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0105.html
